steps.title: Open pi-web
steps.note: One password, one session cookie. The same page serves the control panel and the harness.

steps.title: Give a team a mandate
steps.note: Write what you want done and on which project. The orchestrator drafts the team, you approve it, workers spawn on the PC or the VPS.

steps.title: Follow the thread
steps.note: Each team is a thread with sub-agents you can open. Talk to the lead from the same box; approve pending permissions when it asks.

steps.title: Watch quotas and machines
steps.note: Five-hour and seven-day windows per Claude account, machine gauges, wake the PC, switch accounts.
